pdf_page_count reads the page count of a PDF without rendering a page

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
pdf_bytes = File.read("pdf/sample_contract.pdf").bytes
result = Xberg.pdf_page_count(pdf_bytes)
puts result.inspect
```
